title: Volatility Proxy Comparison: r² vs Parkinson vs Corrected RV
description:
Compared 3 volatility proxies for QLIKE evaluation using SPY GJR-GARCH (w=2000, OOS 2023-2024, 101 sampled days).

Results:
- Squared return (r²): QLIKE = -8.377815
- Parkinson RV (in %%²): QLIKE = 0.219865
- Corrected RV (Parkinson + overnight gap², in %%²): QLIKE = 0.679739

Best proxy: Squared return (r²)

Key finding: Range-based proxies (Parkinson, Corrected) have much lower noise than squared returns, making QLIKE more discriminative for model ranking. The overnight gap correction adds marginal information.
